column1: # Door-to-door subway travel time to Midtown and Lower Manhattan per hexagon
#   - Staten Island Ferry schedule (25-minute crossing): https://www.siferry.com/

#   minutes_to_midtown: minutes from the hexagon center to Times Sq-42 St or Grand Central-42 St: walk to the best station + 5 min wait + scheduled ride with transfers (capped at 150; walking only if that is faster)
#   midtown_capped: 1 if either time was over 150 min (or impossible) and was capped
#   km_to_midtown: straight-line distance from the center to Midtown (between Times Sq and Grand Central)
#   km_to_downtown: straight-line distance from the center to Fulton St
#   minutes_to_nearest_cbd: the smaller of minutes_to_midtown and minutes_to_downtown
#   Walking 75 m/min; 5 min average wait at the first station; transfers between platforms within 300 m cost the walk (x1.3) + 3 min. Waits at transfers are not modelled beyond that
column2: so lines with rare service look a little faster than they are.
